I have 3.14 hectares in total, but this sorghum plot is only 0.34 hectares, so it is not worth buying a full bag of DAP or urea from the cooperative for this small piece when I need that cash for my teff and maize plots. I will put two cartloads of manure on it instead, because I own this land and I have cattle at home. I will plant my own saved sorghum seed from last year; improved seed costs too much and the cooperative often does not even have sorghum seed in stock. My family will work about 35 days on this plot over the season, mostly weeding and chasing birds away from the heads, and I will not hire outside labor because the plot is small enough for us to manage.
